title: Ruffled Tulle Off-Shoulder Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Ruffled Tulle Off-Shoulder Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Off-shoulder maternity photoshoot gown in layered ruffled tulle with long sheer sleeves and a high slit. US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a romantic off-the-shoulder gown in layers of soft ruffled tulle, with long sheer sleeves, a fitted satin-look bodice and an open front with a high slit that lets the bump take center stage.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
ruffled off-the-shoulder neckline, long sheer tulle sleeves, fitted satin-look bodice, open front with a high slit, and a full floor-length tulle skirt with tiered ruffled edges.
Synthetic fiber blend, tulle with a satin-look bodice.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Spot clean or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot. The open front leaves room for the bump; choose by your bust.

image_prompt:
DRESS LIKE MOMMY — RELIABLE PHOTOSHOOT SYSTEM (automated run)

The attached images are the exact reference for ONE Shopify listing: a maternity photoshoot gown, "Ruffled Tulle Off-Shoulder Maternity Photoshoot Gown", in NUDE BLUSH (a warm soft taupe-pink).
The gown (ref1 full length, ref2 and ref3 the same gown): an off-the-shoulder maternity gown in layered tulle: a satin-look fitted bodice with a ruffled off-shoulder neckline, long sheer tulle sleeves with ruffle trim, an open front with a high slit, and a very full, floor-length tulle skirt edged with tiers of ruffles and a sweeping hem. The satin-look bodice and lining are a slightly deeper tone of the same nude blush.

Generate FOUR separate images in this order and save each into the current working directory with exactly these names:
- image1.png — IMAGE 1, MAIN HERO: a visibly pregnant woman (about 7 months) seated or standing in a softly lit photo studio with a plain muted backdrop, wearing this gown, one hand on her bump, the other lifting the tulle so the ruffled tiers fan out and the slit shows; full length, front-facing, gown in sharp focus.
- image3.png — IMAGE 3, BEST OCCASION: the same woman at an outdoor maternity photoshoot in a meadow at golden hour, the tulle skirt and sleeves moving in the breeze; full length.
- image5.png — IMAGE 5, PRODUCT-ONLY: no people. The gown displayed on a white dress form (mannequin) in a bright studio, skirt spread around the base, showing the off-shoulder ruffled neckline, sheer sleeves, slit and tiered ruffled tulle clearly.
- image6.png — IMAGE 6, ALTERNATE LIFESTYLE: the same pregnant woman on a beach at sunset with her partner (a man in a plain white shirt and beige trousers) standing behind her with his hands on her bump; she wears the gown; three-quarter length.
Do not ask me anything; continue until all four files are saved. Keep the same woman across images 1, 3 and 6.

Each output: one single vertical 9:16 photo, no collage, no borders, no text, no watermark. Crop minimally to 9:16 if needed.
PRODUCT LOCK: warm nude blush colour (soft taupe-pink), ruffled off-the-shoulder neckline, long sheer tulle sleeves with ruffle trim, satin-look fitted bodice, open front with a high slit, very full floor-length tulle skirt with tiered ruffled edges. No logos, no letters, no extra embellishment, no belt, no sequins.
MODEL STYLE: a natural-looking European woman, fair to light-medium skin, warm smile, tasteful and elegant; a different woman from the reference photos.
STRICT QUALITY CHECK before saving: reject and regenerate if the gown design or colour changed, she does not look pregnant, extra text appears, it is a collage, not 9:16, or it looks fake.
When all four files are saved, reply with one line per file: name, width x height.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
